clarifiedText: A controller SHALL be able to initiate a REC-alert.
comparisonNote: Matches with the source passage in the spec.
actionNote: Vendor to provide a certification document verifying REC-alert functionality for controllers.

clarifiedText: A driver SHALL be able to initiate a REC-alert.
comparisonNote: Matches with the source passage in the spec.
actionNote: Train Operator to conduct tests and produce a report verifying REC-alert initiation by drivers.

clarifiedText: A controller SHALL be able to initiate a REC-alert by selecting one addressed area.
comparisonNote: Matches with the source passage in the spec.
actionNote: Vendor to produce a design document detailing the selection process for addressed areas.

clarifiedText: A controller SHALL be able to initiate a REC-alert by selecting several addressed areas.
comparisonNote: Matches with the source passage in the spec.
actionNote: Vendor to run simulations and report results verifying multiple area selection functionality.

clarifiedText: When a controller initiates a REC-alert by selecting several addressed areas, the resulting addressed area SHALL be the union of the selected addressed areas.
comparisonNote: Matches with the source passage in the spec.
actionNote: Vendor to update design document to include area union logic for REC-alerts.

clarifiedText: A controller SHALL be able to initiate a REC-alert by selecting one initiating area.
comparisonNote: Matches with the source passage in the spec.
actionNote: Vendor to provide certification for initialization of REC-alerts using initiating areas.

clarifiedText: A controller SHALL be able to initiate a REC-alert by providing a specific train functional identity.
comparisonNote: Matches with the source passage in the spec.
actionNote: Vendor to conduct tests and report verifying REC-alert initiation using train identity.

clarifiedText: The system SHALL allow changing additional information during an ongoing REC-alert that is permanently presented to the recipients.
comparisonNote: Matches with source but lacks specific interoperability context.
openQuestion: Are there interoperability concerns for changing information during alerts?
actionNote: ERA to provide references to standards addressing interoperability for REC-alert updates.

clarifiedText: The system SHALL allow adding additional information during an ongoing REC-alert if no additional information was inserted at setup.
comparisonNote: Matches with source but lacks specific modularity context.
openQuestion: Is there a modularity requirement for adding information during alerts?
actionNote: ERA to investigate modularity requirements in standards for REC-alert information updates.

clarifiedText: The system SHALL allow a controller to change the addressed area(s) during an ongoing REC-alert.
comparisonNote: Contradicts spec as it is optional in source.
openQuestion: Should changing addressed areas be mandatory?
actionNote: ERA to resolve conflict by reviewing whether area changes during alerts should be mandatory in standards.
